summary: A* over a GridComponent's cells, kept as its own component so you only pay for it if you add it.
overview: Standalone A* across a grid's cells. Kept separate from GridComponent on purpose: you only pay for pathfinding if you actually add it, and it can be swapped for a different algorithm later without touching the grid or the placer.
useCases: Unit movement on a tile-based board.
Enemy routing around player-placed walls in a tower-defence map.
Checking a route exists before allowing a placement that would block it.

params.tuning: Independent of the grid's own neighbour setting, so the two can disagree — worth keeping them in step.
Leave on for anything with physical size, or diagonal moves will clip through the corner between two walls.

gotchas.title: Paths are recomputed, not cached
gotchas.body: Each request runs a fresh search. Pathing a large crowd every frame is the usual way this becomes the frame's most expensive thing — a flow field suits that case better.
